'''Ejal''' was a [[Evocii]] who lived well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Ejal led his kinsmen in an [[Ejal's uprising|uprising]] against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had stolen the Evocii's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and used the Evocii as cheap labor. The revolt gained significant support and momentum, but it ended when [[Unidentified Evocii|one]] of Ejal's kinsmen betrayed him to the Hutts, who [[Death/Legends|killed]] Ejal in a gruesome fashion as a lesson to other Evocii. Even during the Cold War, Hutts were still fond of Ejal's story, and used it to remind Evocii of the price of defiance and the rewards that came with obedience.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ejal was first mentioned in the "Evocii History" Codex entry in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
